How much does cleaning several units cost?
One wall-mounted AC costs ₪250, two cost ₪450, and three cost ₪600. Contact us for a quote for more units.
Additional diagnostics and VRF or multi-split servicing are priced separately by prior arrangement.
Clear the space beneath the AC, move fragile objects and tell us about any access difficulties beforehand.
Does a submitted request confirm a booking?
No. We will agree on the time, price and scope of work after receiving your request.
Does my AC need a refrigerant recharge every year?
No. Refrigerant circulates in a closed system and is not consumed like fuel. A low level calls for investigation and a possible leak check. We agree on a recharge after checking the system.
How much does an AC refrigerant recharge cost?

The price depends on the model, refrigerant type and quantity, and system condition. Send us the model and describe the problem. Recharging is quoted separately and is not included in cleaning prices.
